<function name="GetEnemyLastTimeSeen" parent="NPC" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the last time an NPC's enemy was seen by the NPC.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<added>2020.06.24</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="enemy" type="Entity" default="GetEnemy()">The enemy to check.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="time" type="number">Last time the given enemy was seen.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
